About Kaluza

 

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

 

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

 

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

 

What you’ll do

 

You’ll work mainly on the Kaluza Energy Retail platform, a single-instance SaaS platform built for scale and technical quality. It’s the foundation for our customers’ decarbonisation work, and we’re now moving it to a multi-tenant, international-ready model so we can take on new challenges and external customers. This is a technical role, so you’ll need to pick up new and existing technologies quickly.

 

- Triage and prioritise support tickets from retailers’ agents based on impact and urgency, using Jira as our service desk tool, and deliver first-time fixes for repeat issues.

- Be the go-to person for impact assessments and root cause analysis. You’ll identify affected accounts or processes and recommend technical fixes through the Kaluza incident process.

- Use sources such as Databricks, Jira and Google Data Studio to spot trends, measure the impact of issues and diagnose the root cause of client tickets.

- Act quickly to stop incidents from getting worse, and support our Problem and Incident Managers throughout the lifecycle of an incident or problem.

- Raise high-quality incidents and problem candidates for product teams, and work with them to get updates and solutions back to customers.

- Manage internal and external stakeholders, setting clear expectations, giving timely updates and working to team KPIs.

- Help define what a great Service Desk looks like at Kaluza.

 

This role includes a place on a 24/7 on-call rota, one week at a time.

What you’ll bring

Essential criteria:

 

- Experience in the energy industry in the UK, Belgium or France.

- Experience investigating support issues and identifying root causes and affected accounts or processes.

 

Ideally, you’ll have:

 

- Experience in a service desk, technical support or similar role, triaging and prioritising tickets using Jira or a similar tool.

- Basic Python scripting skills and experience working with APIs.

- Experience using AI tools such as Claude in your day-to-day work.

- Experience supporting incident and problem management processes (e.g. ITIL)

- Experience analysing data with SQL, using tools such as Databricks.

Tech stack: Jira, Databricks, SQL, Python, Google Data Studio

 

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

 

- Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

- Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

- Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

- Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

- Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

 

Our Perks

 

- Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

- Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme,
